test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following definitions best describes the concept of microfinance?

options.text: A microfinance institution is a company registered under the Companies Act, 1956, and engaged in the business of loans and advances and acquisition of shares/stocks/bonds/debentures/securities issued by the government.
Microfinance is a banking service provided to unemployed or low-income individuals or groups, who otherwise would have no other access to financial services.
A microfinance institution is a digital-only and mobile-first bank.
Microfinance refers to providing banking services to individuals living in rural areas.

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Microfinance involves providing financial services like small loans, savings accounts, and insurance to people who do not have access to traditional banking services, particularly those in impoverished or rural areas. 
 
• The goal is to empower these individuals or groups by offering them the opportunity to start or expand small businesses,
 
• It improve their quality of life, and reduce poverty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are incorrect or incomplete descriptions of microfinance:
 
• Option 1 describes the business structure of a microfinance institution but does not fully capture the core concept of microfinance itself.
 
• Option 3 describes a digital-only bank but doesn't specifically relate to microfinance.
 
• Option 4 is somewhat related but does not fully explain the concept of microfinance, as it also applies to low-income or unemployed individuals, not just those in rural areas.
